basic.name: Hehe! Don't Get Burned!
basic.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Hook's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Hey! Remember Hook?
skill.description_template:
Deals Fire DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Hook's ATK to a single enemy. In addition, there is a 100% base chance to inflict Burn for 2 turn(s). 
When afflicted with Burn, enemies will take Fire DoT equal to {{dot}}% of Hook's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

variants.name: Hey! Remember Hook?
variants.description_template:
Deals Fire DMG equal to {{main_damage}}% of Hook's ATK to a single enemy, with a 100% base chance to Burn them for 2 turn(s). Additionally, deals Fire DMG equal to {{adjacent_damage}}% of Hook's ATK to enemies adjacent to it. 
 When afflicted with Burn, enemies will take Fire DoT equal to {{dot}}% of Hook's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

ultimate.name: Boom! Here Comes the Fire!
ultimate.description_template:
Deals Fire DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Hook's ATK to a single enemy. 
After using Ultimate, the next Skill to be used is Enhanced, which deals DMG to a single enemy and enemies adjacent to it.

talent.name: Ha! Oil to the Flames!
talent.description_template: When attacking a target afflicted with Burn, deals Additional Fire DMG equal to {{additional_dmg}}% of Hook's ATK and regenerates 5 extra Energy.

technique.name: Ack! Look at This Mess!
technique.description:
Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Hook deals Fire DMG equal to 50% of her ATK to a random enemy. In addition, there is a 100% base chance to inflict Burn on every enemy for 3 turn(s). 
When afflicted with Burn, enemies will take Fire DoT equal to 50% of Hook's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

2.name: Innocence
2.description: Hook restores HP equal to 5% of her Max HP whenever her Talent is triggered.

4.name: Naivete
4.description: The chance to resist Crowd Control Debuffs increases by 35%.

6.name: Playing With Fire
6.description: When using her Ultimate, Hook has her action Advanced Forward by 20% and Hook additionally regenerates 5 Energy.

eidolons.name: Early to Bed. Early to Rise
Happy Tummy. Happy Body
eidolons.description: Extends the duration of Burn caused by Skill by 1 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Don’t Be Picky. Nothing’s Icky
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1. up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: It's Okay to Not Know
eidolons.description: When Talent is triggered, there is a 100% base chance to Burn enemies adjacent to the target enemy, equivalent to that of Skill.

eidolons.name: Let the Moles' Deeds Be Known
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Always Ready to Punch and Kick
eidolons.description: Hook deals 20% more DMG to enemies inflicted with Burn.
